description: Create or fetch a participant, then create a participant-scoped mobile SDK token via GrowSurf REST. Participant creation is trusted direct enrollment and bypasses the public application review flow for affiliates. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

isAffiliate.description: Sets whether the participant is an affiliate. Use `true` only for trusted direct enrollment. Public applicants should follow the program's configured application flow.

language.description: The language of the participant's portal and program emails. Stored when it is one of the program's languages (`languages` in `growsurf_get_campaign_options`). A regional tag maps to its language (for example, `fr-BE` is stored as `fr`). Any other value is ignored and the program's base language applies. Applies only when this call creates the participant. Omit it to use the program's base language. Supported codes: `en`, `es`, `fr`, `de`, `it`, `pt-BR`, `nl`, `pl`, `sv`, `tr`, `ja`, `ko`, `zh-CN`, `id`, `da`, `nb`, `nn`, `fi`, `is`, `cs`, `sk`, `hu`, `ro`, `hr`, `sl`, `et`, `lv`, `lt`, `el`, `bg`, `uk`, `ru`, `pt-PT`, `ca`, `vi`, `ms`, `fil`, `af`, `sw`, `zh-TW`, `es-419`.

referredAt.description: When the participant was referred, in Unix milliseconds. Used only with a valid `referredBy`. If you omit `referralStatus`, GrowSurf compares this time with the program's referral credit window to set it. Defaults to the time of the request.

name: growsurf_create_mobile_participant_token

isNew.description: Whether this request created a new participant.

participant.description: The participant record (same shape as the `growsurf_get_participant` result).

participantToken.description: Participant-scoped bearer token for GrowSurf mobile SDK participant endpoints.

title: Create Mobile Participant Token
